Growth Terminal logs every forecast and grades it against real revenue once the outcome is known. Eight of sixty-seven are graded so far. We are not publishing a coverage percentage until there are twenty, because a rate built on eight results tells you nothing. You can watch the number move.

Run the free 60-second diagnostic, link in bio.
